Taxes Committee
Wednesday, April 17th, 2024
08:30 AM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill
Weber, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Grant Hauschild,
Senator Jeremy R. Miller, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam

Excused: Senator Kari Dziedzic

Senator Klein called the meeting to order at 8:35 a.m.
Approval of the minutes from 4/16/24.
The minutes were approved as presented.

S.F. 5061: Senator Cwodzinski: City of Minnetonka special tax increment financing
authority provision.

Testifier:
Julie Wischnack, Community Development Director, City of Minnetonka

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5061 be laid over.

S.F. 5109: Senator Cwodzinski: City of Eden Prairie special rules for tax increment
financing authorization.

Testifier:
Dave Lindahl, Economic Development Director, City of Eden Prairie

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5109 be laid over.

S.F. 3513: Senator Limmer: Maple Grove tax increment financing special rules
authorization.

Senator Weber moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Mark Steffenson, Mayor, City of Maple Grove

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3513, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 5001: Senator Mann: Edina tax increment financing districts five-year rule extensions
and duration extensions authorization.

Testifier:
Bill Neuendorf, Economic Development Manager, City of Edina

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5001 be laid over.
S.F. 5238: Senator Kupec: Moorhead special tax increment financing authority provision.

Testifier:
Derrick LaPoint, President and CEO, Downtown Moorhead Inc.

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5238 be laid over.

S.F. 3482: Senator Westlin: Plymouth special tax increment financing authority
authorization.
